blocks.text: TOKYO, Japan — So many Filipino girls dream of becoming a beauty queen. But Binibining Pilipinas Katrina Anne Johnson was so certain of which pageant she had hoped to represent the Philippines in, and she shared about it at the 2026 Miss International Preliminary Evaluation. The Japan-based pageant conducted its pre-final evaluation at the Professional University of Beauty and Wellness in Yokohama, Japan, on Monday afternoon, Nov. 23. Aside from the interview round, the ladies also participated in the swimsuit segment, the only time at the entire pageant that they get to parade in swimwear.
